name: Hash Calculator
tagline: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 from any text
description: Instantly compute cryptographic hashes from any text or string. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 algorithms. Useful for verifying data integrity, storing passwords, and fingerprinting content.

expert_defs.name: hash_calculator_compute
expert_defs.description: Computes a cryptographic hash of the given text using the specified algorithm. Params: text (string to hash), algorithm (md5/sha1/sha256/sha512, default sha256). Returns JSON with output_type text and the hex digest.

conceptTexts: Plugin: Hash Calculator (id: hash-calculator). Expert hash_calculator_compute computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512 hash of any text string using Python stdlib hashlib. Params: text (string to hash, required), algorithm (md5/sha1/sha256/sha512, default sha256). Returns {output_type: 'text', data: '<hex digest>', label: '<ALGO> Hash'}. Use run_expert('hash_calculator_compute', {text: '...', algorithm: 'sha256'}) to compute a hash.
